meta.name: social-media-analyzer
meta.description: Analyzes social media campaign performance across platforms with engagement metrics, ROI calculations, and audience insights for data-driven marketing decisions

copy.tagline: 分析社媒活动表现，优化营销决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要数据驱动地评估社交媒体活动效果。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze social media campaign performance to optimize marketing decisions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need data-driven evaluation of social media campaigns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析社交媒体营销活动数据，计算互动率、ROI 等指标，并给出受众洞察和优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提供社交媒体活动数据（如点赞、评论、花费等），并要求分析表现或计算 ROI 时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 Facebook 广告活动的互动率。
say.note: Claude 会计算并展示互动指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze social media campaign data, calculate engagement metrics and ROI, and provide audience insights and optimization recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide social media campaign data (e.g., likes, comments, spend) and request performance analysis or ROI calculation.

say_en.text: Analyze the engagement rate for this Facebook ad campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate and display engagement metrics.

say_en.text: Calculate ROI for this Instagram ad campaign with $500 spend and 2,000 clicks.
say_en.note: Claude will provide ROI and cost efficiency analysis.
